parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch or handle of a faucet, typically made of stainless steel for durability and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the water flow and temperature by rotating or lifting the handle to adjust the internal valve mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to open or close the water flow, providing smooth manual control.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the frame or base of the faucet, usually made of brass for strength and resistance to corrosion.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the switch and connects to the plumbing system, ensuring a stable mount and sealing against leaks.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides structural support for the faucet assembly.
